messages:
alex_k: Heads up — I need to merge PR #8167 (refactor request batching) before the deploy freeze on 2026-03-20 14:00 UTC. CI is flaking on `integration/tests/batching` though.

jess_r: got it. what's the current CI status? failing consistently or intermittent? :thinking_face:

alex_k: intermittent. two runs passed, third failed with a timeout in the connector mock. logs show `TimeoutError: read timed out` inside `batch_runner`.

sam_o: I skimmed the logs — looks like the test hit a slow path when the fake upstream delayed acks. Not sure if it's our change or just infra noise.

ci-bot: rerun requested by <@jess_r>. Build queued: build-18932. ETA ~6m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria_c: @alex_k if CI keeps flaking we can take the 12:30 UTC rebase slot tomorrow (before freeze) and do a manual canary. Would that work?

alex_k: yes that works. Ideally I merge before the freeze but if we need a rebase slot that's fine. I can try a quick fix to mock timings and re-run.

jess_r: @sam_o can you give a quick LGTM after CI is green? You're the last reviewer.

sam_o: will do. if build passes I can review + approve in ~15–20m.

ci-bot: build-18932 passed all stages. Integration tests: 124/124 passed.

alex_k: nice, rebase done locally, pushing now. pinging @sam_o for final check before merge. :pray:

sam_o: quick look — minor nits inline but nothing blocking. Approving once CI finishes the post-rebase run.

ci-bot: post-rebase run queued: build-18945. ETA ~8m.

release_manager: small reminder — deploy freeze window starts 2026-03-20 14:00 UTC. If this merges before 13:30 UTC we'll go green on today's canary plan. After that we need an explicit rebase slot.

alex_k: build-18945 passed. merging in 30s. thanks everyone. :tada:

jess_r: thanks for moving fast. can you add a short note to the release thread about the flaky test so we can follow up if it recurs?

alex_k: yep added a bullet in #releases. will file a follow-up ticket to isolate the mock timing and add a guard.

maria_c: great — if it flakes again ping me and i'll reserve the rebase slot.

sam_o: :thumbsup:
